description: This file defines the 'Ceiling' class that implements various ceiling rounding functions such as CEILING, CEILING.MATH, and CEILING.PRECISE for a spreadsheet calculation library. It contains methods to perform ceiling computations, handle array inputs, and provide error handling.

classes.name: Ceiling
classes.description: Provides static methods to perform ceiling rounding operations, including CEILING, CEILING.MATH, and CEILING.PRECISE, compatible with Excel functions.

methods.name: ceiling
methods.description: Calculates the ceiling of a number or array of numbers, rounding up away from zero to the nearest multiple of significance.

methods.name: math
methods.description: Performs ceiling rounding based on options, including handling negative numbers with modes.

methods.name: precise
methods.description: Round a number up, away from zero, to the nearest multiple of significance, similar to CEILING.PRECISE.

methods.name: ceilingMathTest
methods.description: Helper to determine if ceiling math needs to be applied based on significance, number, and mode.

methods.name: argumentsOk
methods.description: Validates arguments and determines if the result should be zero or a ceiling value, returning error if invalid.

methods.name: floorCheck1Arg
methods.description: Checks for argument validity based on compatibility mode.
